name: Wyvern Roost
summary: Designed to house the Outpost's network of trade and transport, Roost's are a vital element of the continued success and expansion.
effects: Designed to house the Outpost's network of trade and transport, Roost's are a vital element of the continued success and expansion.

attrs.Traits:
The Roost makes all Hexes within a radius of T a valid Transit Route, so long as it connects to the Anguiari by an unbroken sequences of Transit Route Hexes.
-
Time Constraints
Building a Structure takes time, equal to its Tier, Durability, and Resource Costs added up in Weeks. So, a Mine would take four Weeks / a Month to obtain. You can Deplete a Growth Token to remove one Week from the built time of any Structure, but all Structures take at least one Week to build.

summary: Perhaps underhanded, by doubtlessly effective; the Snare is one of the eldest means of defense.
effects:
The Snare may be played to any Zone, and inflicts T Notches to the first Attacker that enter it. Being used this way destroys the Card.
Only one Snare may be active in the same Zone.

name: Aether Pylon
summary: An obelisk of stone, sheathing an intricate heart of Artifice within, allowing the device to link to the Cardio-alembic and propagate its Ward. The creation of the Pylon was one of the original indications that the Great Commission was possible in the first.
effects:
This Structure can be placed anywhere, and provides Stable Aether and Air to a single Hex, like the Cardio-alembic. This also allows Exterior Structures to be placed in that Hex, and for Ships to fly there without risk.
Pylons cannot function without a Linked Alembic, and an Alembic can only support up to 6T Pylons at once.

name: The Gate of Nascia
summary: The final key of the Great Commission. The Nascene Gateway allows for the transportation of matter across space with almost no interval of time. Their promise is twofold, allowing the transport of essential goods from Shard to Shard, and the eventual linkage of the whole Sea by networks of Gateways; This, of course, is the ultimate goal, to re-unify the entire world.
effects: This opens a Transit Route from the Hex placed in back to the Outpost, regardless of any intervening distance at all. This is also a method of travel, allowing teleporation from Gate to Outpost, and for Mines and other Structures from entirely different Shards to benefit the home Outpost.

Difference in Outpost and normal City Growth
Cities normally gain new Zones or have major changes when their Stats do. This is not necessarily the case for an Outpost that Players control. First, all new Zones are at Player discretion, if they happen, and require an in-game Month to take effect in their City.

summary: The heart of Faith, the Temple is established by the placement of an Ordained Keystone, blessed with the authority of the totality of the Priesthood.
effects: The heart of Faith, the Temple is established by the placement of an Ordained Keystone, blessed with the authority of the totality of the Priesthood.

By communing with the Keystone, one can advance their Training in Faith without the need of a Mentor. Likewise, all Priests have a Buff of one to their Faith within a Temple.
-
Unholy Creatures cannot enter a Temple, unless their Tier is greater or they are permitted by a Priest.
